h: Package sha256 implements the SHA224 and SHA256 hash algorithms as defined in FIPS 180-4.

BlockSize.h: The blocksize of SHA256 and SHA224 in bytes.

New.h: New returns a new hash.Hash computing the SHA256 checksum. The Hash also implements encoding.BinaryMarshaler, encoding.BinaryAppender and encoding.BinaryUnmarshaler to marshal and unmarshal the internal state of the hash.

New224.h: New224 returns a new hash.Hash computing the SHA224 checksum. The Hash also implements encoding.BinaryMarshaler, encoding.BinaryAppender and encoding.BinaryUnmarshaler to marshal and unmarshal the internal state of the hash.

Size.h: The size of a SHA256 checksum in bytes.

Size224.h: The size of a SHA224 checksum in bytes.

Sum224.h: Sum224 returns the SHA224 checksum of the data.

Sum256.h: Sum256 returns the SHA256 checksum of the data.
